description: Search the full text of Izzet's public papers and posters for passages about a method, result, dataset, or term. Returns the best passages with their paper id and section; follow up with get_paper_section to read more. Covers only papers with a public PDF or preprint: use search_publications for the catalog of all work.

query.description: Specific terms, e.g. 'how AgentStage infers file paths'

name: search_paper_text
